notes: Sales main line (415) 555-0100 texts fail with "Message not sent"; direct number and Support line deliver. Whole sales team affected since this morning. Asks: retry button and a clearer error.

segments.speaker: Alex Rivera
segments.text: Hey Jordan, it's Alex from IT. I saw your note about texting. Can you walk me through exactly what happens?

segments.speaker: Jordan Ellis
segments.text: Sure. I'm in the RingCentral app, on the Text tab. I open Priya Shah's conversation, from Northwind Dental. That thread is on our Sales main line, the four one five, five five five, zero one hundred number.

segments.speaker: Jordan Ellis
segments.text: I type my reply, hit Send, and it says, Message not sent, with a reference number. Then I switch the Send from dropdown to my direct number, and the exact same message goes through fine.

segments.speaker: Jordan Ellis
segments.text: Support line works too. It's only the Sales main line. It started this morning, and the whole sales team is seeing it.

segments.speaker: Alex Rivera
segments.text: Got it. So expected behavior: any reply from the Sales main line should be delivered, just like the other numbers. Anything else you noticed?

segments.speaker: Jordan Ellis
segments.text: Yeah. When it fails, it keeps my text in the box, which is nice. But there's no retry button, and the error doesn't say why it failed.

segments.speaker: Alex Rivera
segments.text: Perfect, that's really helpful. I'll get this over to QA. Thanks, Jordan.

notes: Wants 40 RingEX Advanced seats; needs revised quote with 3-year discount before Friday. CFO signs. Follow up by text from Sales main line.

segments.speaker: Priya Shah
segments.text: Hi Jordan, it's Priya at Northwind Dental. Do you have a minute on the quote?

segments.speaker: Jordan Ellis
segments.text: Of course. Where did you land?

segments.speaker: Priya Shah
segments.text: We want forty RingEX Advanced seats. Our CFO will sign before Friday if the three year discount is in the revised quote.

segments.speaker: Jordan Ellis
segments.text: Great. I'll send the updated quote today, and I'll text you from the Sales main line when it's in your inbox.

segments.speaker: Priya Shah
segments.text: Perfect. Texting is easiest for me, I'm between patients most of the day.

notes: Desk phones re-registered after reboot. Voicemail-to-email transcripts blank since Monday; a supplier call logged as missed but the phone never rang. Open a case and text the case number.

segments.speaker: Mia Torres
segments.text: Hi, this is Mia at Harbor Coffee. The back office desk phones are registered again after the reboot, thanks.

segments.speaker: Jordan Ellis
segments.text: Glad to hear it. Anything else going on?

segments.speaker: Mia Torres
segments.text: Two things. Since Monday, the voicemail emails arrive with an empty transcript. And yesterday the call log showed a missed call from a supplier, but the phone never rang.

segments.speaker: Jordan Ellis
segments.text: Got it. Voicemail transcripts blank since Monday, and a missed call that never rang. I'll open a case and text you the case number.
